control: Every model has its own default address. Read yours out of set mode and write it down; a wrong address is the usual reason a program sees nothing.
Set mode. 19200 is the common choice. Drop to 9600 if the link drops characters or the radio stops answering.
Set mode. On means the radio announces every change without being asked, which some programs want and others choke on.
CI-V is not RS-232 and not USB. A CT-17 or an equivalent interface is required; a bare serial or audio cable will not work.
CI-V is a bus. Two radios on one interface need different addresses or they will answer over each other.
